refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: Requires g_admin 1, g_antirush 2 and confirmed internal GUID authentication for players. C/aa grants editor access. Legacy configured levels and GUID permissions remain supported; explicit ACL denials override them. Adding/removing editor GUIDs also requires C/antirush or the configured management level. /aa and console aa share the same permission checks and admin logs. Use !help aa and docs/ANTIRUSH.md for editor commands.
